title: A measurable covariant algebraic basis converts an independent Haar defect into a generating iid field

statement.quantifiers: Countably infinite G, actual ab1,p1−ba nonzero in F2[G], M=Rp, K=Mhat, independent iid environment Omega=F2^G; assume inherited X≅X times K.
statement.assertion: If measurable v_g(omega) in finite-support M form an F2 basis a.s. and v_hg(h omega)=h v_g(omega), evaluation gives Omega times K≅Omega times F2^G, hence X≅X times X.
assumptions: Full basis includes both independence and spanning, not merely an iid factor.
Common conull covariance and basis sets for countably many group elements.
Actual witness and algebraic Haar splitting separately validated; no random basis is supplied.

inputs: iid environment and hypothetical measurable finite-support vector maps, with no uniform radius bound.
outputs: Conditionally compact-group isomorphism, independent entire output field and exact pmp G conjugacy if the basis exists.
interface.precision: Exact modulo null sets; finite windows/approximate covariance insufficient.
costs: No basis algorithm, finite precision/bit bound, radius tail or sampling cost supplied.
Primary FIR/Haar conventions still source-dependent; subgroup theorem does not acquire a global basis.
Conditional criterion is a specific linear realization, not equivalence to all measurable conjugacies.

proof_mechanism: Evaluate k on the random F2 basis.
Fixed environment evaluation is a compact-group isomorphism; Haar gives full iid fair output.
Identical conditional laws give independence from the entire environment.
Countable measurable coordinate inverses yield a measurable mod-null inverse; covariance gives exact equivariance.
Combine with X≅X times K; no residual cancellation/finite-power coloring is used.
obstructions: Finite relation ap0 prevents iid positive-density thinning of generators.
No equivariant global random well-order exists on infinite G.
Subgroup bases may be incompatible with other G elements; finite-power Bernoullicity remains unproved.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Construct finite-support combinations satisfying covariance, independence AND spanning, or obstruct this precisely scoped class.

review.source_reported: Source written derivation and exact scopes reported; no source diagnostic code supplied; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
